None should say the Prophet is better than Jonah bin Matta; angered when an Ansari slapped a Jew over Moses, he forbade ranking Allah's prophets above one another.
The Prophet said no one may say he is better than Jonah bin Matta, and whoever says so is a liar.
The Prophet said nobody has the right to say he is better than Jonah bin Matta.
The Prophet says no one has the right to be better than Jonah bin Matta, and whoever says the Prophet is better than him lies.
The Prophet reported his Lord saying no slave should say he is better than Jonah son of Matta.
